decision_conflict_message: Someone else already decided this — reloading.
decision_conflict_suggestion: The list is refreshing with the latest verdict. Review it and decide again if you disagree.
network_offline_suggestion: Check your internet connection and try again.
timed_out_message: The request took too long to complete.
timed_out_suggestion: Try again — if the problem persists, simplify your request or check your connection.
http_client_message: Could not establish a network connection.
http_client_suggestion: Check your internet connection and firewall settings.
auth_invalid_message: Your session has expired or is invalid.
auth_invalid_suggestion: Sign out and sign back in to refresh your session.
oauth_timeout_message: The authorization window was open too long.
oauth_timeout_suggestion: Try connecting again and complete the sign-in promptly.
permission_denied_message: You don't have permission to perform this action.
permission_denied_suggestion: Check that you have the right access level, or ask an admin for help.
forbidden_suggestion: You may not have permission for this action. Check your credentials or contact an admin.
usage_limit_weekly_message: Claude's weekly usage limit was reached.
usage_limit_weekly_suggestion: Runs will keep failing until the weekly limit resets — pause schedules or upgrade your plan.
usage_limit_window_suggestion: The run retries automatically when the window resets — no action needed.
rate_limit_suggestion: Wait a moment and try again.
rate_limited_suggestion: Wait a few seconds before retrying.
budget_limit_message: This agent has reached its spending limit for the month.
budget_limit_suggestion: Increase the budget in Settings or wait until the next billing cycle.
budget_exceeded_message: Budget limit reached — execution was blocked.
budget_exceeded_suggestion: Adjust the agent's monthly budget to continue.
cli_not_found_message: The AI backend (Claude CLI) is not installed.
cli_not_found_suggestion: Install the Claude CLI and restart the app.
cli_config_conflict_message: A configuration conflict is blocking the AI backend.
cli_config_conflict_suggestion: Restart the app — this usually resolves automatically.
cli_error_message: The AI backend returned an unexpected error.
cli_error_suggestion: Try again. If it keeps happening, check the Claude CLI logs.
cli_no_output_message: The AI did not return a response.
cli_no_output_suggestion: Try again with a simpler request.
connector_design_message: Could not generate a connector from your description.
connector_design_suggestion: Be more specific — include the service name and credential type (e.g. "Stripe API key").
generation_failed_suggestion: Try rephrasing your request with more detail.
invalid_json_suggestion: Check that your input is properly formatted and try again.
validation_suggestion: Review the highlighted fields and correct any errors.
n8n_invalid_shape_message: This file doesn't look like an n8n workflow export.
n8n_invalid_shape_suggestion: Open your workflow in n8n, choose Download (or use the API to export the workflow JSON), and upload that file. See https://docs.n8n.io/workflows/export-import/ for the full export steps.
body_too_large_message: The data you're sending is too large.
body_too_large_suggestion: Reduce the size of your input and try again.
ocr_file_too_large_message: This file is too large for OCR.
ocr_file_too_large_suggestion: Drive OCR sends the file inline to the model. Limit is 20 MB. Split the document or extract selected pages first.
decryption_message: Could not decrypt — the passphrase may be wrong or the file is corrupted.
decryption_suggestion: Double-check your passphrase and try again.
circular_chain_message: This would create a loop where agents trigger each other endlessly.
circular_chain_suggestion: Review your agent chain and remove the circular reference.
not_found_message: The requested item could not be found.
not_found_suggestion: It may have been deleted. Refresh and try again.
connection_limit_suggestion: Disconnect an existing peer before adding a new one.
webhook_error_message: The external service returned an error.
webhook_error_suggestion: Check that the webhook URL is correct and the service is available.
zapier_message: Could not reach the Zapier webhook.
zapier_suggestion: Verify the webhook URL in your Zapier integration settings.
inactive_suggestion: Activate the automation before running it.
no_webhook_message: No webhook URL has been set up for this automation.
no_webhook_suggestion: Add a webhook URL in the automation settings.
no_credential_message: This automation is missing its credentials.
no_credential_suggestion: Add the required credential in the automation settings.
empty_bundle_message: The import file is empty or damaged.
empty_bundle_suggestion: Try re-exporting from the source and importing again.
invalid_bundle_message: This file doesn't appear to be a valid export bundle.
invalid_bundle_suggestion: Make sure you're importing a file that was exported from this app.
generic_suggestion: Try again. If the problem persists, restart the app or check your connection.
interval_too_fast_message: Polling can't run more than once per minute.
interval_too_fast_suggestion: Use a polling interval of 60 seconds or higher (300 / 5 min is a safe default). Click Refine and tell the agent to slow the cadence.
interval_not_number_message: The polling interval isn't a valid number.
interval_not_number_suggestion: Open Refine and ask for a numeric polling interval like "every 5 minutes".
webhook_missing_secret_message: This webhook trigger is missing its signing secret.
webhook_missing_secret_suggestion: Re-run Promote — the pipeline auto-generates a webhook_secret on submit. If it persists, restart the build.
smee_url_invalid_message: The webhook source URL needs to come from smee.io.
smee_url_invalid_suggestion: Open https://smee.io/new in a browser, copy the channel URL, and paste it into the webhook source field.
schedule_missing_timing_message: Scheduled triggers need either a cron expression or a polling interval.
schedule_missing_timing_suggestion: Click Refine and specify when the agent should run (e.g. "every weekday at 8am" or "every 30 minutes").
invalid_trigger_type_message: The build picked a trigger type the runtime doesn't recognise.
invalid_trigger_type_suggestion: Click Refine and ask for a specific trigger ("on schedule", "on webhook", "when X happens"). If you keep hitting this, restart the build.
polling_url_blocked_message: The polling URL was rejected for safety.
polling_url_blocked_suggestion: The URL points at an internal/private address. Use a publicly reachable HTTPS URL or switch the trigger to webhook + smee.io.
build_no_agent_ir_message: The build hasn't finished generating yet — the agent's plan is still being assembled.
build_no_agent_ir_suggestion: Wait a few seconds and try again. If it persists for more than a minute, restart the build with a more specific intent.
agent_ir_parse_message: The build output came back malformed.
agent_ir_parse_suggestion: Click Refine to regenerate, or start a new build — refining tightens the result.
design_result_parse_message: The persona's saved design data couldn't be parsed.
design_result_parse_suggestion: Run a fresh build for this persona — the cached design is from an older app version.
build_session_disappeared_message: This build session was cleared before it finished.
build_session_disappeared_suggestion: Start a new build — the previous draft is no longer recoverable.
build_session_gone_message: This build session has expired or been cleared.
build_session_gone_suggestion: Start a new build with the same intent.
build_nothing_to_promote_message: The build hasn't produced anything to promote yet.
build_nothing_to_promote_suggestion: Wait for the build to finish generating, or click Refine to nudge it. If the wizard is stuck for more than a minute, restart.
name_invalid_suggestion: Pick a short, descriptive name (1–40 characters) and try again.
system_prompt_empty_message: The persona's system prompt is empty.
system_prompt_empty_suggestion: The build pipeline normally fills this in. Refine the build, or start a new one with a more specific intent.
prompt_too_large_message: The agent's prompt is too long.
prompt_too_large_suggestion: Click Refine and ask for a tighter version, or remove redundant sections.
max_turns_range_message: The turn limit is outside the allowed range.
max_turns_range_suggestion: Set max turns to a value between 1 and 50.
max_concurrent_range_message: The concurrency limit is out of range.
max_concurrent_range_suggestion: Set max concurrent runs to a value between 1 and the engine ceiling shown in Settings.
timeout_range_message: The timeout is outside the allowed range.
timeout_range_suggestion: Pick a timeout between 1 second and the engine ceiling (typically 30 minutes).
budget_value_invalid_suggestion: Use a positive number for the dollar budget (e.g. 5 for $5).
importance_range_message: Memory importance is out of range.
importance_range_suggestion: Pick a value between 1 and 10 for memory importance.
unknown_prompt_field_message: The build emitted a field the runtime doesn't recognise.
unknown_prompt_field_suggestion: Click Refine — the new build will use the current schema.
oauth_revoked_suggestion: Reconnect the account to grant access again.
retry_exhausted_message: This kept failing after several automatic retries.
retry_exhausted_suggestion: Wait a bit and try again — if it persists, check the service status or the agent's configuration.
keyring_lost_message: The secure credential store is no longer available.
keyring_lost_suggestion: Restart the app. If it persists, re-enter the affected credentials in the vault.
authorization_required_message: This tool needs your authorization before it can run.
authorization_required_suggestion: Open the authorization page to grant consent, then try again.
external_service_message: The external service couldn't complete the request.
external_service_suggestion: Check the service status and your connection, then try again.
_comment_adoption_answers_rejected_messa: Toast shown when the backend refuses a saved template setup questionnaire. Keep to one short sentence.
adoption_answers_rejected_message: Some questionnaire answers are missing or not valid.
_comment_adoption_answers_rejected_sugge: The recovery step for the message above. 'setup questions' = the adoption questionnaire the user filled in.
adoption_answers_rejected_suggestion: Reopen the setup questions and complete the ones named, then continue.
trigger_unschedulable_message: This trigger was refused because nothing would ever start it.
trigger_unschedulable_suggestion: The reason is in the error detail — usually a missing cron expression or interval, or a timezone that is not an IANA zone name like "Europe/Prague". Fix that field and save again.
trigger_type_not_storable_message: This app version cannot store that trigger type.
trigger_type_not_storable_suggestion: Pick a different trigger type. If the app was just updated, restart it once so the database migration that widens the accepted types can run.
workflow_file_empty_suggestion: Export the workflow again from its source app, then upload the new file.
workflow_unsupported_type_message: That file type can't be imported.
workflow_unsupported_type_suggestion: Upload a .json export from n8n, Zapier or Make, or a .yml/.yaml GitHub Actions workflow.
workflow_read_failed_message: The file could not be read.
workflow_read_failed_suggestion: Make sure the file still exists and isn't open in another program, then try again.
workflow_file_too_large_message: That workflow file is too large to import.
workflow_file_too_large_suggestion: Remove unused nodes or split the workflow, then export it again.
workflow_too_many_entries_message: That workflow has too many entries to import.
workflow_too_many_entries_suggestion: Trim the export down — delete unused steps or nodes — and upload it again.
workflow_too_deep_message: That workflow is nested too deeply to import.
workflow_too_deep_suggestion: Flatten deeply nested groups or sub-workflows before exporting again.
workflow_invalid_yaml_message: The YAML in that file could not be read.
workflow_invalid_yaml_suggestion: Check the file for indentation or syntax mistakes, then upload it again.
workflow_not_an_object_message: That file doesn't contain a workflow.
workflow_not_an_object_suggestion: Upload the workflow export itself, not a fragment, a list or an unrelated file.
workflow_platform_unknown_message: The workflow platform could not be identified.
workflow_platform_unknown_suggestion: Import an export from n8n, Zapier, Make or GitHub Actions — other formats aren't supported yet.
workflow_shape_rejected_message: That export is missing the parts a workflow needs.
workflow_shape_rejected_suggestion: Re-export the complete workflow from the source app — this file has no usable steps or nodes.
